scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.docker.yml --profile apps up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.docker.yml --profile apps down
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.docker.yml --profile apps logs -f tickets-service tickets-relay notifications-service notifications-email-retry directory-service web
